entries.text: Good evening, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]![VAR 0x0114(0045)]
entries.label: s1_sub_015_caretaker_02

entries.text: We are very grateful for all you did to help clear\nup that horrible confusion over dear Ogerpon.[VAR 0x0114(0045)]
entries.label: s1_sub_015_caretaker_03

entries.text: I never dreamt that the “Loyal Three” were in the\nwrong—and that poor Ogerpon was the victim![VAR 0x0114(0045)]
entries.label: s1_sub_015_caretaker_04

entries.text: Why, we would have gone on passing down the\nwrong story without a second thought![VAR 0x0114(0045)]
entries.label: s1_sub_015_caretaker_05

entries.text: All that being said![VAR 0x0114(0045)]
entries.label: s1_sub_015_caretaker_06

entries.text: While I do fully understand that the Loyal Three\nwere villains...[VAR 0x0114(0045)]
entries.label: s1_sub_015_caretaker_07

entries.text:
You’ve seen the state of Loyalty Plaza, yes?\c
The statues are ruined—shattered to pieces when
those three were resurrected!\c
Doesn’t it pain your heart to see it so?[VAR 0x0114(0045)]
entries.label: s1_sub_015_caretaker_08

entries.text: And only too right! I knew a student of a fine\nacademy like yours must appreciate the\r\nsignificance of such a site![VAR 0x0114(0045)]
entries.label: s1_sub_015_caretaker_09

entries.text:
Oh? You DID see what that place looked like
before the monument was destroyed, didn’t you?\c
I’m sure you mourn for the loss of such a site,
even if your words tell another story.[VAR 0x0114(0045)]
entries.label: s1_sub_015_caretaker_10

entries.text:
Yes, the actual “Loyal Three” were in the wrong.
But the monument brought so many touri—\c
I mean, it brought so much comfort and hope to
the people of our village for generations.[VAR 0x0114(0045)]
entries.label: s1_sub_015_caretaker_11

entries.text:
Which is why...\c
I have begun a fundraiser to restore that beloved
site to its former state—and I am calling it the
[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]“We Love Loyalty Plaza” drive[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]![VAR 0x0114(0045)]
entries.label: s1_sub_015_caretaker_12

entries.text: We are looking for donations of 10,000, with\nthe ultimate goal of gathering 1,000,000![VAR 0x0114(0045)]
entries.label: s1_sub_015_caretaker_13

entries.text: Be that as it may, I couldn’t possibly take that\nkind of money from a student such as yourself...[VAR 0x0114(0045)]
entries.label: s1_sub_015_caretaker_14

entries.text: But perhaps you could subtly nudge your parents\nor teachers to contribute to our cause![VAR 0x0114(0045)]
entries.label: s1_sub_015_caretaker_15

entries.text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]We’ve collected a total of [VAR 0x0206(0001,002C)] so far for\nthe\r\n[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]“We Love Loyalty Plaza” drive[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]![VAR 0x0114(0045)]
entries.label: s1_sub_015_caretaker_16

entries.text: I’ll give [VAR 0xBD03(0000)]10,000
entries.label: s1_sub_015_select_01

entries.text: Maybe next time
entries.label: s1_sub_015_select_03

entries.text: You’d be so kind as to give 10,000 to our\nfundraiser?[VAR 0x0114(0045)]
entries.label: s1_sub_015_caretaker_17

entries.text: Goodness me! You really wish to give us an\nentire 100,000 at once?![VAR 0x0114(0045)]
entries.label: s1_sub_015_caretaker_18

entries.text: We’ll reach that 1,000,000 in due time—\nyou’ll see! And I’ll be here until we do![VAR 0x0114(0045)]
entries.label: s1_sub_015_caretaker_19

entries.text: It seems you don’t have enough money to make\nthat sort of donation...[VAR 0x0114(0045)]
entries.label: s1_sub_015_caretaker_20

entries.text: Well, I accept your kind support with gratitude!\nAnd here—a little something for you in return.[VAR 0x0114(0045)]
entries.label: s1_sub_015_caretaker_21

entries.text: Our goal is to raise a total of 1,000,000, and\nwe’ve raised [VAR 0x0206(0001,002C)] so far![VAR 0x0114(0045)]
entries.label: s1_sub_015_caretaker_22

entries.text: With that donation— O-oh my...[VAR 0x0114(0045)]
entries.label: s1_sub_015_caretaker_23

entries.text: We’ve reached our goal of 1,000,000![VAR 0x0114(0045)]
entries.label: s1_sub_015_caretaker_38

entries.text: Now we can at last restore Loyalty Plaza to the\nway it was![VAR 0x0114(0045)]
entries.label: s1_sub_015_caretaker_24

entries.text: Let me call our contractor at once...\n*beep* *boop* *beep* *beep*[VAR 0x0114(0045)]
entries.label: s1_sub_015_caretaker_25

entries.text: Hello? Yes, yes, it’s me again. We were able to\nraise the funds for the project!\c\nWe’d love to see work get started at once![VAR 0x0114(0045)]
entries.label: s1_sub_015_caretaker_26

entries.text: They say they’re already done! Why don’t we\nhead over to see the fruits of your labor?[VAR 0x0114(0045)]
entries.label: s1_sub_015_caretaker_27

entries.text: Ohhh... Would you just look—![VAR 0x0114(0045)]
entries.label: s1_sub_015_caretaker_28

entries.text: Thanks to our “We Love Loyalty Plaza” drive,\nthe old monument has been reborn![VAR 0x0114(0045)]
entries.label: s1_sub_015_caretaker_29

entries.text: Goodness, did they ever do a fine job! It’s hard\nto believe it’s not the exact same monument![VAR 0x0114(0045)]
entries.label: s1_sub_015_caretaker_30

entries.text: We even re-created the scratches and blemishes\nit had before!
entries.label: s1_sub_015_worker_01

entries.text: Hahaha! Now THAT is true craftsmanship and\ndedication for you![VAR 0x0114(0045)]
entries.label: s1_sub_015_caretaker_31

entries.text:
This is just what the village needed!\c
Yes, just what we needed...to draw in more
tourists who’ll want to take photos here!\c
We’ll be topping the tourism charts in no time![VAR 0x0114(0045)]
entries.label: s1_sub_015_caretaker_32

entries.text: Hurray! Hurray! Come on, all together now![VAR 0x0114(0045)]
entries.label: s1_sub_015_caretaker_37

entries.text: You learned the [VAR 0xFF00(0008)]Hurray! emote [VAR 0xFF00(0000)]from the\ncaretaker!
entries.label: s1_sub_015_system_02

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]I also have a special gift for you,
[VAR 0x0100(0000)],
for
being
our
number
one
supporter.[VAR 0x0114(0045)]
entries.label: s1_sub_015_caretaker_33

entries.text: You obtained the[VAR 0xFF00(0008)] Festival Jinbei (Flashy)[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]!
entries.label: s1_sub_015_system_01

entries.text: We had a bit left over from the fundraiser, so\nI went ahead and glammed that up for you.[VAR 0x0114(0045)]
entries.label: s1_sub_015_caretaker_34

entries.text: Wear it out and about to advertise the wonders\nof Kitakami to all your friends in Paldea![VAR 0x0114(0045)]
entries.label: s1_sub_015_caretaker_35

entries.text: Hmm... Perhaps my next goal should be to open\nup a stylish café at Loyalty Plaza...[VAR 0x0114(0045)]
entries.label: s1_sub_015_caretaker_36
